subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — BCP/DR artifacts and RTO/RPO snapshots
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@brightbank.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightBank Sec Team <sec@brightbank.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — initial ask for BCP/DR artifacts

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the call this morning. BrightBank's InfoSec team is working through the SIG/CAIQ questionnaire and we need a few concrete BCP/DR deliverables to close our risk review for the pilot project. Can you provide the following by EOD Thursday?

- A short (1-2 page) operational runbook excerpt that demonstrates recovery steps for inference-serving (warm cache, KV restore, model fallbacks).
- RTO and RPO test artifacts from the last two drills (timestamps, duration, outcomes).
- A list of on-call contacts and escalation matrix for the service.

I attached our trimmed SIG matrix (BrightBank_SIG_Questions.pdf) with line references; we flagged the BCP/DR rows we want evidence for.

High level: BrightBank needs to confirm you meet our 30-minute RTO for control-plane failovers and 15-minute KV-cache-populate expectation for the pilot. If the artifacts show a different number, please call out compensating controls.

Thanks,
Sara Lopez
Security Review Lead — BrightBank

Attachment: BrightBank_SIG_Questions.pdf (pdf, 128 KB)

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@brightbank.com>
Cc: BrightBank Sec Team <sec@brightbank.com>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — initial ask for BCP/DR artifacts

Sara — thanks for the clear list and the flagged SIG matrix. We're happy to provide the artifacts you asked for. Quick plan and owners: 

- Runbook excerpt (ops steps for inference restart, warm cache strategy, fallback model routing): Michael will draft a 1–2 page extract and attach.
- RTO/RPO test artifacts: Naomi will pull the drill timestamps and produce a CSV with measured recovery durations and brief notes.
- On-call contacts and escalation matrix: Ben will export the contact vCard and an escalation table.

We can meet your timeline — aiming to have deliverables to you by Thu EOD PT. If BrightBank needs the RTO number hardened to 30 minutes exactly we can include a compensating SLA note and a recommended warm-warm standby configuration (cost/benefit bullets).

I'll post the artifacts to a shared folder and send the link + short README. If you prefer encrypted upload, let me know and we'll use the SFTP channel.

Camila Reyes
Enterprise Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
Phone: +1 415 555 0183

--

Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Runbook excerpt + drill artifacts (draft)

Camila / Naomi / Ben — putting my draft here for Camila to review before we publish to BrightBank.

Attached: RI_Runbook_Sample-2027-07.pdf (1.6 MB) — excerpted runbook showing:
- Sequence: control-plane failover initiation -> model fallback activation -> KV restore & prefix warm-populate -> traffic ramp-back procedure.
- Key timings annotated (cache-seed: ~9–12 minutes for small 50k key set on p4d equivalent; model swap < 2 minutes).
- Operational checks and automated rollback hooks.

Naomi: can you add the drill CSV (RTO_RPO_Snapshot-2027-07-18.csv) and include a short note for any tests that exceeded our internal target? I called out two compensating controls we can surface if BrightBank needs the strict 30-minute RTO: instant snapshot rollbacks and cross-region pre-warmed pools.

Ben: please export the on-call vCard and the escalation matrix we use for Dedicated/Private customers. Small ask: make sure the matrix shows both phone and Slack channels and the escalation SLA tiers.

Sara — pinging you here. We'll upload the package to the shared drive and send a link once Camila signs off.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior Site Reliability Engineer

Attachment: RI_Runbook_Sample-2027-07.pdf (pdf)

From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@brightbank.com>
Cc: michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — BCP/DR package uploaded

Sara — package uploaded and link below. Summary of what we included and one callout:

Included artifacts:
- RI_Runbook_Sample-2027-07.pdf — 2-page runbook excerpt showing recovery steps and automated checkpoints.
- RTO_RPO_Snapshot-2027-07-18.csv — two most recent drill runs (timestamps, measured RTO/RPO, test notes).
- ops-team-contacts.vcf — on-call contacts + escalation matrix (phone + Slack).
- short README.md with precise definitions and the compensating-control notes (warm-warm standby cost table).

Callout: our measured control-plane failover median was 27 minutes across the last two drills; KV warm-populate averaged 11 minutes for the dataset size used in the pilot. That meets BrightBank's 30-minute RTO target and is comfortably under the 15-minute KV target when combined with our recommended warm-warm option (notes in README).

Shared link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/brightbank/sig-response-2027 (access: BrightBank-sec@brightbank.com)

If you want a one-page summary for your SIG packet that lists the exact SIG rows and which file maps to each row, we can provide that by Friday.

Camila Reyes
Enterprise Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)

Attachments: RI_Runbook_Sample-2027-07.pdf, RTO_RPO_Snapshot-2027-07-18.csv, ops-team-contacts.vcf
